selection_scope: Exploratory full-font TTF comparison, DPR1 primary, light/dark; final acceptance uses ttf14-comparison.json, not these research candidates.

candidates.A: Conservative eye frame for U+6525; crown-only adjustment for U+87A3 had little visible benefit.
candidates.B: Stronger U+6525 frame expansion produced less balanced counter spacing.
candidates.C: Larger U+87A3 crown trim did not materially open the important lower space.
candidates.D: Selected: conservative U+6525 frame; U+87A3 terminal dot and matching inner wedge shift right, retain stroke weight.
candidates.E: Thinner lower U+87A3 rail did not improve default TTF lower fixed ROI.
candidates.F: Combined rail/dot thinning did not outperform D in default TTF lower fixed ROI.

research_cleanup: Temporary candidate fonts and layout-specific study pages were removed after final full-build outlines and hmtx matched selected D for all glyphs. The selected guarded source plan and final production-font A/B are retained.
limits: No claim of universal ROI improvement, recognition accuracy, or cross-platform readability.
